name: formation_code
description: Unique FBR field formation code (e.g. LTO_KHI

name: formation_name
description: Official full name of the FBR tax office formation

name: formation_type
constraints: Allowed values: LTO (Large Taxpayers Office), CTO (Corporate Tax Office), MTO (Medium Taxpayers Office), RTO (Regional Tax Office)

name: principal_city
description: Primary urban center / city housing the formation headquarters

name: province
constraints: Allowed values: Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan, Islamabad Capital Territory

name: latitude
description: Geographic latitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) for mapping

name: longitude
description: Geographic longitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) for mapping

name: direct_tax_income_tax_pkr_billion
description: Direct taxes collected including Corporate Tax

name: sales_tax_pkr_billion
description: Domestic and import sales tax collected (PKR Billion)

name: total_tax_collected_pkr_billion
description: Total net tax revenue collected by the formation (PKR Billion)

name: share_of_national_tax_pct
description: Percentage share of national FBR tax collection

name: active_taxpayers_filers_count
description: Estimated active taxpayer filers registered under this tax formation
